# Keeper physical

Menu. Pick from this when NOOP is green and the tape showed a physical cause. Yellow drops diving and plyo. Red is not this page.

## First step

8–12m sprints. Come / stay decisions at walking pace first if recovery is yellow.

## Set

Isometric set holds. Short reaction work. Not extra diving on a yellow day.

## Dive

Only on green, and only if the tape showed a dive problem. Rec keepers over-dive. Default is set.
